system.description:
Growing Unique (studded leather +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): Advantage on Survival and Perception checks in the wild.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the armour is +2; once per day, cast polymorph on yourself, into a beast only.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the armour is +3, and your beast form keeps your own HP.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
